title: セントライト記念の後に・昇竜と伏龍

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And she's passed the finish line! Kitasan Black has conquered the distance and proved that running 2,200 meters is no obstacle to her!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… I-I did it! I kept up a solid pace all the way to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I might not have anything to set me apart, but I was still able to stay in the front and run to the very end! This…)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is how I run! This is how I live! This is the only path I can take, but it's all mine!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'm not a prodigy or elite runner.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All I can do is throw myself wholeheartedly into my training and keep my nose to the grindstone.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And I'll prove my worth. I'll make it to the stage where only genuinely strong Umamusume can stand—just by working slowly and steadily!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black, huh? She doesn't have any cool and flashy moves, and she's always on the brink of being overtaken, but…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: The way she puts 110% into whatever she does is pretty impressive, huh? Especially today…
You're perfectly right. Kita always tries her absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, aren't you…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond?! I-is that really you?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita will only get stronger from here. So please…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please continue to cheer for her. She is a wonderful Umamusume who truly deserves it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia! You came to watch me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I did. You were superb on the track. Thank you for such a wonderful showing. I also have something to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It seems my debut is finally at hand, and I'll soon be entering the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I may not be anywhere near your level yet, but…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I swear I will catch up with you, so you have to do your very best at the Kikuka Sho, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You bet! I can't wait to race with you one day, especially since we still have our promise to keep! But, before we race each other…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: There's someone I have to beat… There's an Umamusume I have to settle the score with first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A towering gate, the pinnacle of her generation—Brusquement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black will never be able to move on to the next stage if she doesn't beat her at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black! Trainer! This is bad! Quick, turn on the news!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The news?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We turn on the TV, and the first thing we see is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brusquement's trainer surrounded by a throng of reporters.

text_block_list.name: Astute Trainer
text_block_list.text: Yes, surgery. Something was amiss after the Derby, and we are continuing to discuss the best course of action moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Astute Trainer
text_block_list.text: However, Brusquement will not be running in the Kikuka Sho. She will focus on recovery for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait… She's pulling out of the race?! Now what, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My brain is firing on all cylinders. If her most powerful rival is out of the picture, then we'll need to rework our strategy from square one.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Will she be okay? Even if she will be, she won't be in the Kikuka Sho anymore…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I had finally prepared myself emotionally to give that race everything I had too…
choice_data_list: Let's just calm down for now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Sorry about that. This is all just so sudden…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I have to get ahold of myself and switch gears. I don't think I can do it right away, so I'll just take it slow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series is no cakewalk. The moment you clear one hurdle, another one pops up to take its place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have to help Kitasan Black so she'll be able to run well in the Kikuka Sho, even without her biggest rival there to drive her forward.
